tasks.build: deno bundle --frozen --platform=browser --external=cloudflare:workers src/worker.ts -o dist/worker.js && echo 'export * from "../src/worker.ts"; export { default } from "../src/worker.ts";' > dist/worker.d.ts
tasks.generate-types: deno task build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false deno run -A --frozen npm:wrangler@4.148.0 types --include-runtime=false --strict-vars=false
tasks.dev: deno task prepare && deno task build && celld dev wrangler.jsonc --host 127.0.0.1 --port 44200 --logs
